🎬 Day 10 of 30 – SQL Interview Questions Series!

Today’s question:
 What’s the difference between COUNT(*), COUNT(1), COUNT(-1), COUNT(NULL) and COUNT('SQL') in SQL?

In this video, I explain:
 ✅ What each COUNT expression actually evaluates
 ✅ Why COUNT(1), COUNT(-1), and COUNT('SQL') all return the same result
 ✅ How COUNT(column) behaves differently when NULLs are involved
 ✅ Common misconceptions around COUNT(*) and COUNT(1)

📊 If you're preparing for SQL interviews or want to master SQL internals, this is a must-watch breakdown!

🎥 YouTube video link is in the comment 👇

If you find this video helpful, consider subscribing to my YouTube channel “Crack DE with Mradul” for more SQL and data engineering content.

I’d love your support as I continue this 30-day SQL Interview Question series!
